title: MineGuessr
description: GeoGuessr inside Minecraft: get dropped at a random spot, study your surroundings, then pin where you spawned on the map. Solo or multiplayer, with difficulties, scoreboard, match history and map review.
body:
# 🗺️ MineGuessr

**GeoGuessr, but inside Minecraft.** You're teleported to a completely random spot in the world with no idea where you are. Look around, study the terrain, the biome, the sun, the structures — then open the map and pin **exactly where you spawned**. The closer your guess, the more points you score.

Every location is real, procedurally generated Minecraft terrain, so no two rounds are ever the same.

> ⚠️ **Beta / test release.** Bug reports and feedback are hugely appreciated!

---

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 The core game
- You spawn at a random point inside a 150-block region, bounded by a world border.
- After a short timer, an **interactive map** of the region opens.
- Click where you think you spawned. Score is **distance-based** (a bullseye = 5000 points), exactly like GeoGuessr.

### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Single-player & Multiplayer
- Play solo, or with friends — **every online player joins automatically**.
- In multiplayer, everyone is dropped at the **same location** each round and guesses independently.
- The round result is **only revealed once everyone has guessed**, so nobody can copy another player's pin.
- Cumulative **scoreboard** across rounds, with player heads and names.

### 🎚️ Difficulties (in-game menu)
Run `/geo start` to open the selection screen:

| Difficulty | Move | Time | Effects |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🟢 **Easy** | Free | 10s | — |
| 🟡 **Normal** | Frozen | 10s | — |
| 🟠 **Hard** | Frozen | 5s | — |
| 🔴 **Insane** | Free | 5s | Blindness |
| 🟣 **Mega Insane** | Free | 5s | Blindness + Night |
| 🛠️ **Custom** | — | — | Toggle movement, blindness, day/night, time & rounds |

### 🧭 A proper map screen
- **Zoom** (scroll) and **pan** (drag) the map.
- **Battleship grid** with A–H columns and 1–8 rows for easy communication ("it's in C5!").
- **Compass (N)** and a **Sun/Moon indicator** (East/West) for orientation.
- **Scale bar** and **structure markers** (villages, pillager outposts, pyramids, and more).
- Snow, ice, water depth and terrain relief are all rendered.

### 🏆 Results, history & records
- A polished **end-of-match results panel** ranking all players.
- 🎆 **Fireworks** when someone nails a perfect 0-block guess.
- Full **match history** with **Multiplayer / Single-player tabs**.
- Click any past match to **review the maps** — see where every player pinged each round and how far off they were. Maps are saved as images, so reviews work anytime.

### 🛡️ Built-in anti-cheat
- Players are **invisible and non-colliding** to each other.
- **F3 coordinates hidden**, **block breaking/placing disabled**, and you're **invulnerable** during a match.

---

## 🎮 How to play

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/geo start` | Open the difficulty selection menu |
| `/geo start <difficulty> [rounds]` | Quick-start a preset (e.g. `/geo start hard 3`) |
| `/geo history` | Browse past matches and review their maps |
| `/geo records` | Show records |
| `/geo stop` | End the current match |

**On the map:** left-click to place your pin · right-click to clear it · scroll to zoom · drag to pan · then confirm.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+
- **Fabric API**

> Install on **both client and server** (or on the host for LAN / Open-to-LAN games).

---

*Made for the Minecraft community. Have fun getting lost! 🌍*
